origin.description: is.mcmc reports whether an object is an mcmc chain. A three-dimensional mcmc array is the layout from before coda 0.4 and stops, telling the caller to upgrade it with mcmcUpgrade.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An object that may be an mcmc chain.

origin.details: Returns TRUE when x inherits from mcmc and is not a three-dimensional array. A three-dimensional mcmc object stops with a message to update it. Anything else, including an mcmc.list, returns FALSE.
origin.value: TRUE or FALSE. A three-dimensional mcmc object does not return; it stops.
origin.example: n <- 2000; i <- seq_len(n); x <- cbind(sin(i/3)+0.2*cos(i), cos(i/5)+0.01*i, rep(2, n)); m <- mcmc(x); v <- mcmc(sin(i/7)); cat(is.mcmc(m), is.mcmc(v), is.mcmc(x), is.mcmc(mcmc.list(m, mcmc(x))), is.mcmc(NULL), "\n")

translation.description: is_mcmc reports whether an object is an Mcmc chain. A three-dimensional chain is the layout from before coda 0.4 and raises ValueError.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An object that may be an Mcmc chain.

translation.details: Returns True when x is an Mcmc instance and its data array is not three-dimensional. A three-dimensional Mcmc object raises ValueError with the R upgrade message. Anything else, including an McmcList, returns False.
translation.value: True or False. A three-dimensional Mcmc object raises ValueError.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from coda.as_mcmc import as_mcmc
from coda.is_mcmc import is_mcmc
from coda.mcmc_list import mcmc_list
n = 2000
i = np.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=float)
x = np.column_stack((np.sin(i / 3) + 0.2 * np.cos(i), np.cos(i / 5) + 0.01 * i, np.full(n, 2.0)))
m = as_mcmc(x)
v = as_mcmc(np.sin(i / 7))
print(is_mcmc(m), is_mcmc(v), is_mcmc(x), is_mcmc(mcmc_list(m, as_mcmc(x))), is_mcmc(None))
